services.title: SaaS & Product Videos
services.shortDescription: Turn complex software features into crisp, visually stunning product overviews and investor demos.
services.fullDescription: Specialized video editing for software companies, web3 apps, and hardware startups. I transform Figma screens, screen recordings, and 3D renders into high-converting product videos, changelog updates, and investor pitch decks.
deliverables: Dynamic UI mockups and 3D device framing
Kinetic typography for feature callouts
Custom cursor animations and zoom smoothing
Multiple format exports (16:9 web, 9:16 ads)
High-energy licensed electronic or ambient score

services.title: Real Estate & Architecture
services.shortDescription: Cinematic drone and walkthrough edits that present luxury properties at their absolute finest.
services.fullDescription: Elevate your property listings with high-end architectural editing. Combining smooth camera stabilization, sky replacements, interior window exposure blending, and atmospheric grading.
deliverables: FPV and standard drone speed-ramping
Interior room-by-room stabilized flow
Agent intro and branded title cards
Location callouts and amenity overlays
Vertical 9:16 reels for Instagram and TikTok

services.title: Anime Music Videos (AMVs)
services.shortDescription: Frame-accurate beat matching, dynamic velocity graphs, and custom VFX transitions.
services.fullDescription: For content creators and anime communities seeking world-class AMV productions. Focused on frame-perfect synchronization, visual flow, 3D camera projections, and emotive storytelling.
deliverables: Custom velocity curves and time remapping
Masking, rotoscoping, and impact frames
Glow, shake, chromatic aberration, and CC
Audio glitch and SFX layering
1080p / 4K 60fps high bitrate render

services.title: Movie Edits & Trailers
services.shortDescription: Dramatic recuts, conceptual trailers, and cinematic retrospectives that evoke strong emotional resonance.
services.fullDescription: Taking long-form cinematic footage and crafting high-tension narrative trailers or reflective tributes. Masterful attention to soundscapes, dialogue isolation, and thematic progression.
deliverables: Narrative arc and pacing restructuring
Dialogue isolation and remastering
Cinematic foley and sub-bass whooshes
Anamorphic letterboxing and color balancing
Custom cinematic title typography

services.title: Podcast Editing & Multi-Cam
services.shortDescription: Seamless multi-camera switching, studio audio cleanup, and automated vertical short cutouts.
services.fullDescription: Full-service podcast post-production for video podcasts. Includes intelligent speaker switching, removal of dead air and filler words, lower thirds, and repurposing into viral shorts.
deliverables: Multi-angle synchronization and switching
Voice leveling, noise suppression, and de-reverb
Animated lower thirds and guest handles
3-5 viral vertical clips with animated captions
Timestamped YouTube chapters

services.title: YouTube Videos & Retention
services.shortDescription: Data-backed retention editing with hooks, chapter visualizers, sound effects, and zero-fluff pacing.
services.fullDescription: Designed for creators who want to skyrocket their Average View Duration (AVD). Every cut, zoom, sound effect, and graphic element is engineered to keep viewers glued to the screen.
deliverables: First 30-second high-impact retention hook
Custom sound effects library integration
Motion graphics for complex explanations
Pacing optimization to prevent audience drop-off
Rendered in full 4K with optimized YouTube bitrate

services.title: Reels, Shorts & TikToks
services.shortDescription: High-cadence vertical videos with viral pacing, engaging motion captions, and sound triggers.
services.fullDescription: Short-form video dominates social discovery. I build vertical videos designed specifically for algorithmic reach on Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.
deliverables: Engaging first 3-second visual hooks
Word-by-word animated captions with emojis
B-roll cutaways and zooms every 2-3 seconds
Trending audio integration and audio ducking
Batch delivery options for weekly consistency

services.title: Gaming Montages & Highlights
services.shortDescription: Esports-grade highlight reels with 3D camera pan, velocity graphs, and synchronized beat drops.
services.fullDescription: Highlighting top plays in Valorant, CS:GO, Apex Legends, Call of Duty, and fighting games. Turn raw gameplay recordings into adrenaline-pumping cinematics.
deliverables: Frame-blended optical flow velocity ramping
Kill reaction sound effects and 3D audio panning
Cinematic replay cameras and spectator tools
Custom team/clan branding overlays
60fps high bitrate social and YouTube exports

services.title: Brand Commercials & Ad Creatives
services.shortDescription: High-converting performance ads and brand story pieces that drive clicks and sales.
services.fullDescription: High-performing video creatives for Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, YouTube Pre-Roll, and brand awareness campaigns. Built around tested direct-response frameworks.
deliverables: Multiple hook variations (A/B testing ready)
Clear call-to-action cards and end screens
Color grading matched to brand guidelines
Platform-specific aspect ratios (16:9, 1:1, 4:5, 9:16)
Licensed royalty-free music and SFX

services.title: Motion Graphics & VFX
services.shortDescription: Custom 2D/3D title sequences, screen tracking, logo reveals, and futuristic interface overlays.
services.fullDescription: Add production value with bespoke motion design. Whether you need realistic screen replacements, tracking titles into a 3D scene, or energetic logo stings.
deliverables: Custom 2D/3D title sequences and lower thirds
Corner-pin screen tracking and cleanups
Logo reveals and animated brand stings
HUD interfaces, maps, and technical visualizers
Alpha channel (ProRes 4444) transparent overlays

services.title: Color Grading & Master Finishing
services.shortDescription: Film-look color grading, shot matching, dialogue isolation, and rich atmospheric soundscapes.
services.fullDescription: Transform flat log footage into deep, cinematic imagery with Hollywood-grade color science. Combined with pristine audio mastering so your project looks and sounds like a theater release.
deliverables: Log to Rec.709 conversion and custom film print looks
Shot-to-shot white balance and skin-tone matching
Dynamic exposure relighting and vignette masks
Dialogue cleanup, de-essing, and mastering to -14 LUFS
Multi-layered foley, whooshes, risers, and impact hits

services.title: Captions, Subtitles & Custom Thumbnails
services.shortDescription: Eye-catching click-worthy thumbnails and styled animated captions in 50+ languages.
services.fullDescription: Complete packaging for social media domination. Includes stylized burned-in captions, SRT delivery for accessibility, and high CTR custom thumbnails designed in Photoshop.
deliverables: Kinetic karaoke-style word highlighting
SRT / VTT closed caption files
High-CTR YouTube and Facebook thumbnails (3 variations)
Typography and color palette matched to brand
Fast same-day turnaround option available

settings.heroHeadline: I TURN RAW FOOTAGE INTO VISUAL EXPERIENCES.
settings.heroSupporting: From cinematic edits to high-converting brand videos, I craft visuals that capture attention, communicate ideas, and leave an impression.
settings.aboutBio: I turn ideas and raw footage into compelling visual stories. From cinematic edits and anime AMVs to brand videos, real estate films, and podcast content, I focus on pacing, visual storytelling, color, sound, and detail. Let's create something unforgettable together!
